description: If finite propositional premises entail a conclusion, simultaneous substitution of all premises and the conclusion preserves consequence.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.subst_entails.{u, v} {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [DecidableEq β]
  (σ : α → Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula β) (Γ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α))
  (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α) (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Entails Γ A) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Entails (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.substContext σ Γ)
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.subst σ A)
